- Initial release of turbo-whisper-local-stt.
- Offline, high-performance audio-to-text transcription using Faster-Whisper large-v3-ct2 with Chinese language priority.
- Supports long audio with VAD segmentation, GPU acceleration (int8_float16), and ensures privacy with full local processing.
- Suitable for Chinese meeting recordings, voice notes, and subtitle generation.
- Outputs structured results (full text, segmented info, language detection).
- Compatible with single files or folders; auto-detects environment and GPU, and supports multiple models for varying needs.
